cases.question: Audit my attached rows, then find recovery and acceptance evidence.

result.title: Local event-contract audit
result.text: CSV tool checks event identity, timestamp, taxonomy and duplicates. Conflicting IDs exclude every affected record from provisional counts. A passing contract is not proof of complete instrumentation or business approval. Inputs can be processed locally in the visitor browser.

result.provenance: Visitor-supplied CSV; source authenticity not verified

contract.timestamp: UTC ISO; seconds or exactly three fractional digits
contract.identity: event_id must uniquely identify an immutable event

findings.message: One event ID has conflicting payloads.
findings.action: Resolve the identity collision upstream; do not silently keep the first row.

limitations: Passing these checks is not a release approval or proof of complete instrumentation.
Counts are provisional. All rows sharing a conflicting ID are excluded from provisional counts; do not use this report as a cleaned dataset.
No checks for missing events, identity stitching, consent, revenue reconciliation, freshness, or treatment assignment.
Record numbers count non-empty CSV data records, not physical lines. Findings may overlap; counts must not be added as a rejected-row total.
No raw records or user/event IDs are included in this report. Event taxonomy names remain included.

result.title: Reporting recovery and business requirements
result.text: Executable examples cover replay, late arrivals, rejected data, rollback and restatement. Linked business requirements and acceptance criteria. These are independent work samples, not production client operations.
